kill_criterion.pass_rule: at least one countable result byeolki lacks is in the main body: official submission ids with scores on the post-10/16 board, and a paired probe-vs-control test with the item count needed to separate them
kill_criterion.fail_rule: no scored official id by 2026-11-01 20:55 KST, or every main-body claim already appears in byeolki's report
kill_criterion.stop_rule: on fail, submit v8.3 (W1) with the board section recast to the organizers' planned 240 test instances; no further method work
